articles.title: Anthropic will become a Biotech AI Risk by 2029
articles.content:
早上好，

随着Anthropic距离2万亿美元IPO不到一个月的时间，它即将在生物学、药物发现、生物化学和生物技术领域释放其版本的递归自我改进AI（RSI）。这可能会有哪些问题？递归自我改进AI或其当前版本不应被用于药物研究和生物技术领域。

Dario Amodei及其天使投资人、Google DeepMind的Demis Hassabis曾对AI在未来十年治愈癌症做出了惊人的预言。他们宣称AI有能力将生物学研究的速度提高约10倍，将50至100年的生物学和医学进展压缩为仅5至10年。然而，这种进展将以什么代价实现？Anthropic将在几乎没有监管的情况下踏入危险领域。

我越来越担忧Anthropic将在2030年代拥有的计算能力，这些能力将把其领先世界的模型应用于生物技术领域。这一危险转折的起点是2025年8月，Anthropic吸引了Eric Kauderer-Abrams的加入。他最初成为公司的生命科学研发与合作共同领导，现任生命科学部门负责人，负责实验室运作和AI驱动的药物发现项目。之后，诺贝尔奖得主John Jumper，AlphaFold蛋白结构AI的共同创建者，在Google DeepMind工作了九年后，于6月加入了AI初创公司巨头Anthropic。

美国领先的LLM实验室将尝试实现许多其他药企初创公司未能实现的目标——利用AI加速药物发现。但它已经进行了加速生物学RSI的危险实验。据悉，Anthropic在旧金山湾区设立了一个实验室，用于进行物理生物学实验，公司正在超越基于计算机的研究，以开发罕见疾病的治疗方法，至少这是其公开声明。

在AI的恐惧情绪在公众中蔓延之际，Anthropic将推动世界前沿模型与药物和生物技术理解的结合。本周，Anthropic声称其Claude发现了一个新的酶系统。

articles.summary:
Good Morning,

As Anthropic gets set for a $2 Trillion IPO in just over a month, it’s getting close to unleashing its version of RSI in biology, drug discovery, biochemistry and biotechnology. What could go wrong? Recursive self-improving AI or today’s version of it should not be unleashed on drug research and biotechnology.

Both Dario Amodei and his angel investor, Google DeepMind’s Demis Hassabis have made incredible claims about AI curing Cancer in the next decade. Predictions such like AI being capable of accelerating biological research by roughly 10x, compressing 50 to 100 years of biological and medical progress into just 5 to 10 years. But at what cost? Anthropic will tread dangerous ground without hardly any oversight.

I’m getting increasingly alarmed by the compute Anthropic will have at its disposal to put its world-leading models at the intersection of biotechnology in the 2030s. The beginning of this dangerous turn was when Anthropic lured Eric Kauderer-Abrams who joined Anthropic in August, 2025. He initially came on board to co-lead life-sciences R&D and partnerships, and currently serves as the company's Head of Life Sciences, overseeing its wet lab operations and AI-driven drug discovery programs. Then in June Nobel laureate John Jumper, co-creator of the protein-structure AI AlphaFold, left Google DeepMind after nine years to join the AI startup juggernaut Anthropic.

America’s leading monopoly LLM lab will be trying to do what so many other Pharma startups have failed to do, use AI to accelerate drug discovery. But it will and it has already conducted dangerous experiments along the lines of accelerating RSI in biology. It has now come out that Anthropic has set up a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area to conduct physical biology experiments, as the company moves beyond computer-based research in its effort to develop treatments for rare diseases, or so it claims publically.

At a time when fears of AI are gripping the public, Anthropic will push the limits of the intersection of the world’s frontier models and our understanding of pharma and biotechnology. Anthropic this week claimed Claude discovered a novel enzyme system.
